title: Khosla-backed Mazama Energy just raised $135M to drill deeper into super-hot-rock geothermal | TechCrunch
summary: Mazama plans to start generating electricity sometime next year and said its first site in Oregon is capable of producing 10 gigawatts of electricity. Unlike previous geothermal projects, enhanced geothermal startups are targeting deeper and hotter rock.
